title: Channel Builder Cutter

reuse_decision.reason: Audit: the Cutters chapter had no channel/micro-prong/bright-cut command at all. The menu catalog already listed the four icons and display.rs already expected an om9.cutter payload, but no session resolved or built them, and the M06 scallop owner sweeps one edge profile rather than a stone row. This owner adds the row cutter kernel once and the app dispatches to it.
reuses: OM9-L2-04-16 (cutters::{sweep, loft, solid, volume_mm3}, boolean::{apply, BooleanMode, CutterKeep}, the om9.cutter record)
OM9-L2-04-09 (gem::GemSpec + the gem owner's om9.gem record)
OM9-L2-04-15 (the prong/channel metal owner that consumes these cutters)

previous_code_audit: menu_catalog::CUTTERS listed BuilderChannelBuilder, BuilderMicroProngCutter, BuilderBrightCutChannel and BuilderBrightCutter, and icons.rs bound all four SVGs.
display.rs CutterRecord { kind, seat } and CUTTER_EXTENSION_SLOT existed with no writer.
session.rs resolved none of the four ids: a click fell through the unsupported-command path.
crates/om9-core/src/cutters/ had the gem, library, bezel and boolean kernels but no row cutter geometry.
limitations: The channel is a swept 4-corner prism (one station per stone plus two end caps), not a B-Rep solid.
A channel narrower than its widest stone is refused instead of clipped: the stones sit in the channel it cuts.
The end profiles shape the two end caps only; the middle section (Middle=Wide|Deep) is a third profile.
